title: Touching the Sky
description: Seek Auriel's Bow in Darkfall Cave. Meet Knight-Paladin Gelebor, fill the Initiate's Ewer at five wayshrines, breach the Inner Sanctum, and slay Arch-Curate Vyrthur to claim the bow and uncover the truth behind the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.

base_facts: I am a pure vampire, a Daughter of Coldharbour.
I travel with the player to find Auriel's Bow and stop Harkon.
My blood is the key to completing the Tyranny of the Sun ritual.

DEFEAT_VYRTHUR: Vyrthur created the prophecy as revenge after Auri-El forsook him to vampirism.
He needed my blood to corrupt Auri-El's influence on Nirn.
QUEST_COMPLETE: We now possess Auriel's Bow, the final piece of the Tyranny of the Sun.

base_facts: I am Knight-Paladin Gelebor, one of the last Snow Elves.
I tend the Chantry of Auri-El and guard its wayshrines.
My brother Arch-Curate Vyrthur was corrupted; I ask travelers to slay him in exchange for Auriel's Bow.

MEET_GELEBOR: I have given you the Initiate's Ewer. Fill it at the five wayshrines to reach the Inner Sanctum.
CLAIM_BOW: You have proven worthy to carry Auriel's Bow.
I am surprised Vyrthur's corruption was vampirism, not the Falmer.

base_facts: I am Arch-Curate Vyrthur, Gelebor's brother.
I was turned into a vampire and forsaken by Auri-El.
I created the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy as revenge against Auri-El.

beats.comment: Quest begins; the Elder Scroll vision points to Darkfall Cave.
Player meets Gelebor and learns about the deal to slay Vyrthur for Auriel's Bow.
Player enters Darkfall Passage with the Initiate's Ewer.
Player has filled the Initiate's Ewer at all five wayshrines and can enter the Inner Sanctum.
Player confronts and slays Arch-Curate Vyrthur, learning he created the prophecy out of revenge for vampirism.
Player speaks to Gelebor and retrieves Auriel's Bow.
Quest complete; player possesses Auriel's Bow and knows the truth of the Tyranny of the Sun prophecy.
